ImageDescription.value: A compiled panoramic picture of Ilulissat, Greenland taken in September, 2006. The shipping and fishing port is behind the fuel tanks on the left, the hospital is the large red building near the center of the image, and the power plant is shown furthest to the right of the image. The mouth of the Ilulissat icefjord is south (to the right, on this photo) of the  town. Photo by Paul Cziko

113357718.title: File:In the picture the 40-minute journey that starts from Ilulissat buiobuione.jpg

ObjectName.value: In the picture the 40-minute journey that starts from Ilulissat buiobuione

ImageDescription.value: There are great trails around Ilulissat, two of which start from the city center (yellow trail and blue trail) and run along the Icefjord. Walking along them, in addition to the surrounding flora (in summer) you can admire the extraordinary and constantly changing landscape of the icebergs and it is not uncommon to see the passage of whales. The routes, for everyone and (which have a maximum duration of 40 minutes and two hours the second respectively), can be done safely even on your own and no special equipment is required other than that usually used to protect yourself from the wind and from the cold in these areas. In the photograph the 40-minute journey that leads to the panoramic view of the icebergs
